title: Gate modeling strategy on evidence-bound reference claims
problem: A plausible prose description or silhouette can harden uncertain reference guesses into the wrong representation, component boundary, or depth structure before the model is cheap to revise.

applicability.workflow: reference-driven modeling before and during primary blockout
exclusions: automatic visual inference is not provided
weak or unknown claims cannot drive strategy booleans
policy success is not Blender or reference-fidelity proof

action_policy: Record each important interpretation as OBSERVED, STRONGLY_INFERRED, WEAKLY_INFERRED, or UNKNOWN.
Require concrete evidence for observed and strongly inferred claims.
Block blockout on high-impact weak/unknown claims or contradictory supported modeling signals.
Translate only observed/strongly inferred modeling signals into the strategy brief.
Keep weak areas reversible and preserve rejected construction strategies with reasons.
Verify the resulting Blender geometry and reference fidelity through separate truth channels.

evidence.scope: declared pure-Python policy cases across pendant-lamp and appliance-panel families
evidence.result: supported claims changed representation/component policy; weak claims were ignored; unknown/conflicting claims blocked modeling
PASS: all nine independent serialized-artifact checks confirm the two-family policy result, explicit conflict handling, and the stated no-Blender/no-held-out boundary

promotion_limit: Not TRANSFER_VALIDATED or RUNTIME_VALIDATED until real image interpretation changes Blender construction and improves measured outcomes on unrelated assets.
